_comment: nx is used graph-only here: `nx show projects --affected` answers which .NET projects and which pnpm packages a diff touches (see .github/scripts/affected.sh). Builds and tests still run through dotnet and pnpm; no nx targets are run and nothing is cached.
_sharedGlobals_comment: namedInputs.sharedGlobals: a change to any of these marks every real project affected (the PR workflow then runs the whole PR tier). They reach a project only through a target whose `inputs` include `default`: @nx/dotnet gives every .NET project such targets (and its analyzer already lists the Directory.*/global.json files as evaluation inputs on its own); the viewer and the extension get one via the never-run `ci-affected` target in their project.json. Escalation tiers (.github/ci-tiers/*) deliberately have no such target, so shared files do not escalate.
